name: the detail-page card ignores the Ctrl gate on hover
why: By default (sa_dp_hover_without_ctrl off) only a hover with Ctrl held may schedule the card. Without the gate a pointer crossing the table pops cards and fetches pages again.
grep: by default a plain hover shows nothing

name: pressing Ctrl on a hovered title does nothing
why: Ctrl pressed while the pointer already rests on a title must show its card at once; without the keydown branch only a hover that STARTS with Ctrl held would.
grep: Ctrl pressed while the pointer rests on a title

name: the plain-hover setting is ignored
why: sa_dp_hover_without_ctrl: true restores the old behaviour; read wrongly, a plain hover would stay silent with the setting on.
grep: with the setting on, a plain hover shows the card
